intended_use: Scores personal and two-wheeler loan applicants and recommends approve or reject to a credit officer, who makes the final decision.
out_of_scope: Business loans, loan limit increases for existing customers, and any decision without a credit officer review.
training_data: 36 months of synthetic loan applications (2022-2025): income, bureau score, repayment history. Uses personal data under DPDP consent collected at application.
performance: Validated by the model risk team in Sept 2026: AUC 0.81 on a hold-out set, approval threshold 0.62. Monthly monitoring of AUC and PSI.
fairness: Approval rates compared by gender and region. Gender ratio 0.86 (below the 0.90 target): fairness retest open as FND-003.
limitations: Weak for thin-file applicants with no bureau history; credit officers must review those manually.
human_oversight: Every recommendation is reviewed by a credit officer who can override it with a recorded reason. Overrides are sampled monthly.

intended_use: Flags card and UPI transactions that look fraudulent so the fraud operations team can review them before release.
out_of_scope: Blocking customers or accounts automatically; credit decisions of any kind.
training_data: Vendor model trained on pooled industry transaction data; tuned on 12 months of Kshitij Finserv synthetic transactions.
performance: Vendor reports 92% precision at the current alert threshold; internal sample check in July 2026 found 89%.
fairness: Alert rates compared by customer region each quarter; no region above 1.25 times the average in Q2 2026.
limitations: Vendor can retrain the model without notice (RSK-027); performance drops on new payment types.
human_oversight: A fraud analyst reviews every alert before any transaction is held. Analysts can release a held transaction.

intended_use: Answers customer questions about loan products, EMIs and repayment dates on the website and in WhatsApp.
out_of_scope: Giving credit decisions, changing account details, or giving financial advice.
training_data: Third-party LLM accessed by API; grounded on the public product FAQ only. Customer data is not used for training.
limitations: Can state wrong figures if the FAQ is out of date; cannot see a customer's own loan account.
human_oversight: Customers can type 'agent' at any time to reach a human; transcripts are sampled weekly.
transparency_notice: Every chat opens with: 'You are chatting with Sahayak, an AI assistant. Type agent to talk to a person.'
